_note: The ONLY place sponsor prices live. advertise.html's rate card and meta descriptions are generated from this file by scripts/generate_advertise_pricing.py; house ads in sponsors.json name a slot via price_slot and both renderers (index.html, js/sponsors.js) append that slot's floor at runtime. Change a price here, run scripts/regen_all.sh, done. 'key' matches the slot names in sponsors.json tier[] (radius is a detail-tier variant). Plain text, no HTML: the generator escapes. Prices are USD per 30-day cycle.
